the elucidation of the mechanisms by which FSH stimulates Sertoli cell function.
the mechanism of action of FSH on Sertoli cell calcium metabolism, a key regulatory event in spermatogenesis.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
FSH induces calcium influx by activating voltage-sensitive calcium channels and by inducing formation of transmembraneous aqueous channels.

The main takeaway from our work is that

FSH is able to interact with its receptor and induce calcium flux through both voltage-sensitive and voltage-insensitive channels, and that the FSH beta-subunit is involved in the formation of these calcium-conducting channels.
the FSH beta-subunit has a direct effect on calcium channels in the membrane.
